author: Russell Brand
description:
Russell Brand sits down with Jamie Winship to reveal the profound spiritual meaning hidden within the cover of his new book. The flies forming the shape of the cross is not accidental but a deeply intentional symbol representing how Jesus Christ took upon himself all the shame, filth and punishment of humanity and died on the cross so that we would not have to carry it ourselves. Russell and Jamie unpack why this image is one of the most powerful representations of what the crucifixion truly means and why understanding it changes everything about how we see Christ's sacrifice.

author: Russell Brand
description:
Russell Brand reacts to a recent clip of Dan Bongino and cannot help but notice how dramatically different he looks — like a man who has been exposed to something deeply disturbing far too quickly. Russell reflects on what it must be like to have access to the kind of information Bongino now has and whether the weight of that knowledge is written all over his face. A short but deeply unsettling observation about what happens to people when they get too close to the truth.

author: Russell Brand
description:
Russell Brand sits down with Jim Gale to expose what may be the most powerful and deliberately overlooked control system ever used against ordinary people — food and agriculture. From the nutritional disaster of school lunches to the slow degradation of modern supermarket food Russell and Jim break down how the industrialisation of agriculture has been systematically weaponised to keep populations weak, dependent and compliant. The farmers who grow your food are being squeezed out while the systems that replace them serve power not people. A conversation about the control weapon so embedded in daily life that most people never even think to question it.
